Legs.Subject: BitmapIndex64 over six window shapes (a 13-value window of 64 lanes, a one-value window of one lane, a two-value window, a 64-value window of 37 lanes, a window ending at long.MaxValue and one starting at long.MinValue): fresh, after Load of seeded values, and through 200 seeded single-lane Sets whose values fall inside the window, one past either edge or anywhere in a long; Range over every pair of ends within two of the window and the two extreme longs, the lane reads, Outliers and RangeReads; and the constructor, Set and Load refusals.
Legs.Against: A plain scan of an independent copy of the lane values, which calls no BitmapIndex64 member: the lanes whose copied value lies in each range, the lanes whose value lies outside the window, and the count of window values inside the range taken as the lesser of it and its complement plus one.
